item.title: Version 1.0.21
item.description:
What's new

  • In a session your own pet now sits in the desk row too, next to everyone else, in the same order on every screen.
  • Talk to your session: quick lines or a short message, said by your pet. Click your pet's name tag in the row, or use the Friends tab.
  • Stuck? Ask for help (once every 10 minutes) and the other pets tell their humans that you need help.
